title: The double Bongcloud (Carlsen vs Nakamura)
post: Magnus and Hikaru played the WORST opening in chess… against each other 😂 #chess #story #education #magnuscarlsen #hikaru

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: Magnus Carlsen and Hikaru Nakamura. Move two... both kings walk out.
phrases.say: Magnus Carlsen and Hikaru Nakamura. [mischievously] Move two... both kings walk out.

phrases.text: The Bongcloud. The worst opening in chess.
phrases.say: The Bongcloud. [deadpan] The worst opening in chess.

phrases.text: The king can't castle, and it blocks its own queen and bishop.
phrases.say: The king can't castle... and it blocks its own queen and bishop.

phrases.text: Hikaru loves it. On a new account, he played only the Bongcloud... and still reached three thousand.
phrases.say: Hikaru loves it. On a new account, he played only the Bongcloud... [excited] and still reached three thousand.

phrases.text: Magnus crushed Wesley So with his own version. So's words: that's so humiliating.
phrases.say: Magnus crushed Wesley So with his own version. So's words: [laughs] that's so humiliating.

phrases.text: March 2021. Magnus Carlsen Invitational. Both already qualified.
phrases.say: March 2021. The Magnus Carlsen Invitational. Both already qualified.

phrases.text: Magnus walks his king out. Hikaru bursts out laughing... and copies him.
phrases.say: Magnus walks his king out. Hikaru bursts out laughing... [laughs] and copies him.

phrases.text: Peter Leko, on commentary: please, definitely don't try this at home.
phrases.say: Peter Leko, on commentary: [pleading] please, definitely don't try this at home.

phrases.text: Kings back, kings out. Three times. Draw.
phrases.say: Kings back... kings out. Three times. [deadpan] Draw.

phrases.text: Magnus said: I just wanted to have a little bit of fun.
phrases.say: Magnus said... [casually] I just wanted to have a little bit of fun.

phrases.text: Kasparov didn't laugh: you should pay utmost respect to your viewers.
phrases.say: [serious] Kasparov didn't laugh: you should pay utmost respect... to your viewers.

phrases.text: But who would punish Magnus... at the Magnus Carlsen Invitational?
phrases.say: But who would punish Magnus... [mischievously] at the Magnus Carlsen Invitational?

phrases.text: Two years later, two grandmasters shuffled knights to a draw at the World Blitz. Zero points, for both.
phrases.say: Two years later, two grandmasters shuffled knights to a draw at the World Blitz. [serious] Zero points, for both.

phrases.text: Fun, or disrespect? Rate the double Bongcloud from one to ten.
phrases.say: [curious] Fun... or disrespect? Rate the double Bongcloud from one to ten.
